q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
## Analysis

**(a) Time left until resolution**

The earnings release is scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close. Today is August 25, 2026. Resolution occurs within approximately 24 hours.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why**

The question asks for NVIDIA's **forward guidance** for Q3 FY2027 revenue in the Q2 earnings release on August 26.

Based on the research:
- Current consensus estimate for Q3 FY2027 revenue is **$103.8 billion**
- Jefferies (a veteran analyst) forecasts **$108 billion**, approximately $4.3 billion above consensus
- The guidance range provided ($99.5B - $115.5B) is quite wide, centered roughly around $107.5B

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will issue forward guidance clustered around the consensus range of $103-108 billion. The company has been known to issue slightly conservative guidance that they can beat, but they also tend to provide aspirational guidance when they have strong demand signals (which they clearly do in the AI/data center market).

**(c) What would push the value lower?**

- Concerns about demand softening or macro headwinds
- Geopolitical restrictions impacting sales (particularly China exclusions mentioned)
- Conservative approach to forward guidance to maintain credibility
- Weakness in non-data-center segments offsetting AI strength
- Guidance at or below the $103.8B consensus midpoint

**(d) What would push the value higher?**

- Exceptionally strong bookings and demand signals from cloud customers
- Jefferies' $108B forecast gaining traction with management
- Confidence in maintaining high capacity utilization
- Upside surprises in Q2 actual results encouraging higher Q3 guidance
- Extension of guidance above $108B reflecting robust pipeline

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values**

No reliable base rate available from the provided research for NVIDIA's historical guidance patterns. However, the research indicates:
- Q2 guidance was $91B (±2%), with Wall Street at $91.9-92.07B (slightly above midpoint)
- This suggests NVIDIA tends to provide guidance near but slightly below Wall Street consensus
- Applying this pattern to Q3 would suggest guidance near the $103.8B consensus, potentially reaching toward $105-108B

**(Analysis of the distribution)**

Given:
- Consensus: $103.8B
- Jefferies: $108B
- Range bounds: $99.5B - $115.5B
- Historical tendency to guide near but slightly below consensus
- Strong demand environment supporting upside

I estimate the guidance will fall in the $104-108B range, with a median around $106B. The lower bound of $99.5B would represent a significant miss vs. consensus (unusual for NVIDIA). The upper bound of $115.5B seems unlikely without extraordinary circumstances, though not impossible in this AI-driven environment.

**Calibration:** The company has strong momentum, Jefferies provides a credible upside case at $108B, and management would be confident issuing guidance in the $105-108B range while still maintaining optionality to beat.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on Wednesday, August 26, after market close, which will include forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued in May, called for revenue of $91.0 billion (plus or minus 2%), explicitly excluding any data center compute revenue from China [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). Wall Street's average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.9 billion to $92.07 billion, placing it within NVIDIA's guidance range but slightly above the midpoint [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).

Looking ahead to Q3 FY2027, the current consensus revenue estimate is $103.8 billion [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). However, Jefferies forecasts a Q3 FY2027 revenue of $108 billion, approximately $4.3 billion above current expectations [finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/1-veteran-analyst-sees-nvidia-115749161.html). A key point to watch will be whether the Q3 guidance also maintains the exclusion of China data center revenue [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/).
